446174623.body: fpkg pkg support is experimental , and a pkg game can run worse than the same game in zstd packs. if a game stutters as a pkg, try it in zstd packs and tell us in an issue what s new a new file index: every game s index is kept in memory as one compact table, built once when the game starts. it needs less memory, has no fixed 48 mib cap, and opening a packed file no longer reads its path from disk data ampr cache no longer shows in a file explorer fixes large games that would not start with index tables need ... mib, over the 48 mib : final fantasy xvi 53, 67 , demon s souls 61 and returnal 72 new game crash in marvel s spider-man: miles morales 63 : the save icon path ran out of stack on the game s save thread stuck on closing... with ce-108255-1 in ai limit 60 , and saves that could not be created 64 : a busy save mount is now passed back to the game instead of being retried after unmounting its other saves 66 loading stuck at 20 or 60 after loading a save in horizon forbidden west 23, 68 folder handles of packed folders are now numbers below 1024, since some games reject larger ones 58, 70 a folder is no longer hidden by a file with the same name in another case thanks jamesst20 tracked down the spider-man crash from core dumps 71 moved folder handles below 1024 70 , wrote a core dump payload, and dug through three wolverine crash dumps 48 strongt1me fixed the save mount retry 66 , documented the ampr emu.index rules for packer authors 69 , and found from the logs why demon s souls and ff16 did not fit in memory 61, 67 bxymartin, in a first contribution, fixed the horizon forbidden west loading hang 68 dotpinheiro for the save mount investigation in 62 thanks to everyone who tested builds and sent logs: mrfireos 60 walkerallen96082 61 , zedan015 67 , fecent 72 , xavi871b 64 myselfayman2-sys and linchiech 63 , libraaaaa2792 65 olizo53 48 and privatepasta 52 how to use fpkg games: launch with kraken-mount zstd, lz4 and folder games: copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in its settings or kraken mount zstd and lz4 packs can be made with ps5-dump-forge please keep reporting how your games run with the game report form, and name the format: pkg, zstd, lz4 or folder

446208902.body: now that s a proper release version all fpkg files are now supported, even sparse ones the web ui and the notifications are in 11 languages ampr-emu-ng v0.4.1 is bundled. app can now check for ampr-emu-ng updates by itself a game moved to another drive or folder is relinked without a rebuild kraken mount waits for kstuff to launch, and for shadowmount to stop, before it mounts anything new games now register on setups where only elfldr runs system ex was read-only there thanks strongt1me 22 the web ui is lighter: covers load the 512x512 icon first, and the background photo is gone to update, send kraken-mount.elf once to elfldr port 9021 . existing caches are kept; the first start after the update only refreshes each game s fakelib thanks to everyone who tested fpkg games and sent feedback on this new way of launching them without installing
